title: anthemis cretica subsp. panachaica
intro: Anthemis cretica subsp. panachaica, commonly known as Rock Anthemis, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family, native to the Mediterranean region. It is known for its health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues, and has been traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of indigestion, diarrhea, and stomach cramps. The therapeutic actions of Rock Anthemis include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
